name: codex-boot-animation
description: Local videos for Codex desktop startup, new chats, reactions, idle returns, and confirmed task completion on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Startup, new-chat, reaction, idle, and task-completion videos.
interface.longDescription: A Windows companion uses independent startup, new-chat, reaction, idle, and completion video folders. One MP4 in a folder plays every time; several are chosen randomly within that folder. After 15 minutes without input, return activity resets a two-second quiet timer. One idle clip can fill only the Codex window; further input dismisses it. Local hooks conservatively trigger reactions and task completion without storing prompt text. Native video windows are separate from Codex UI. Windows packaged Codex only; community alpha release.
defaultPrompt: When does the Codex intro play, and how can I skip it?
